description: Return the most recent console output lines for a specific instance (by id or exact name), oldest first. Only the server's last 300 lines are kept, so pass `contains` to pick out what you need from all of them; for anything older, read_file /logs/latest.log with `contains`. Useful for diagnosing crashes or checking recent activity.

contains.description: Only return lines whose text, prefix or event tag contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "lost connection" or "minecraft.login_attempt". All 300 kept lines are searched before `limit` applies.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return, counted from the most recent. 1-300.

name: get_console_output
title: Get Console Output
